name: Battle Blocks
summary: Battle Blocks is an inventive hybrid of puzzle gaming and tower defense. Small towers combine to create powerful mega towers that can destroy or block enemies, or fuel super-weapons that can change the tide of battle. And just when you need it a powerful 4th tower type is introduced. Only the right balance of towers, quick thinking puzzle play, and nerves of steel will see you through all 50 waves of enemy assaults. Incredible replay value as no two games are exactly the same.
